## Certified findings & active caveats (replace former "Confirmed capabilities")

| Finding | Evidence | Caveat / Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| *(STRUCK D-019)* ~~"Abstention instead of confident error"~~ | `graveyard/0007` (`agent-c`) | `key not in dict` at 0% unseen coverage equals `lambda _: ABSTAIN`; G8 now requires risk–coverage curve vs thresholded baseline (`AMEND-001`). |
| **Carry state necessity** | `0002-*-agent-c.md` §3 | `2555/2555` V1 errors occur when incoming `carry=1` collides with a `(digit_a, digit_b)` entry learned under `carry=0`. |
| **In-split role sharing at equal budget (200 entries)** | `k3control.py` §R1 (`agent-d`) | Shared role table `100.00%` vs unshared `0.00%` vs 2,942-param one-hot MLP `29.21%` (`96.9%` units). **CAVEAT (`certify.py` C4):** D4/role-table hardcodes `c = (x+y+c)//base` in Python; carry was **not** learned! |
| **Unseen-symbol representation split (`R2([9])`, `R2([7,8,9])`)** | `k3control.py` §R2 (`agent-d`) | Role table: `0.00%` coverage (`0` wrong, `100%` abstain). One-hot MLP: `1.18%` / `0.55%` (`7,906` / `7,956` wrong). **Ordinal-12 MLP: `18.99%` / `11.39%`** (`6,481` / `7,089` wrong). Directly exposes CHARTER §4's discrete-exact vs continuous-transfer tension. |
| **Bounded state ≠ unbounded exact recall** | `RESULTS.md` §A, `graveyard/0002` | Pigeonhole; exact recall requires bounded RAM + addressable store with `O(1)` reads/token (G2–G4). |
